typography.installation: Add Google Fonts imports for 'DM Sans' and 'DM Mono' to index.css or index.html

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Glassmorphism for floating elements and primary cards. Use `bg-[#18181b]/60 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10`.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px subtle borders `border-white/5` or `border-white/10`. No heavy shadows; rely on border contrast and ambient glow.
visual_enhancers.glow: Subtle `#c9a962` ambient drop shadows for active elements or critical CEO notifications.
visual_enhancers.textures: Minimal noise overlay on the primary background to eliminate digital flatness and create a 'graphite' premium feel.

components.sidebar: Fixed left navigation. `w-[260px] h-screen bg-[#09090b] border-r border-white/5`. Active state uses `#c9a962` left border accent and slightly tinted background.
components.metric_card: High-density data card. `bg-[#121214] border border-white/5 rounded-lg p-4`. Values in `DM Mono`.
components.briefing_panel: Primary focal point. Contains "What changed, what to decide, what to delegate". Slightly elevated surface with glassmorphism.
components.button: Primary: `bg-[#c9a962] text-black hover:bg-[#e5c57f] font-medium rounded-md`. Secondary: `border border-white/10 text-white hover:bg-white/5 rounded-md`.
components.chat_interface: 'Ask Kalun' AI chat. Needs a distinct input area, minimal bubbles, and an executive tone. AI recommendations highlighted with a champagne gold border or icon.
components.risk_matrix: Grid or scatter plot charting risks vs. impact. Use Recharts with custom tooltips.
components.kanban_board: For Tasks section. Columns with border collapse styling, minimal card design, high density.

grids.dashboard_bento: High density grid. `grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4`. Every pixel utilized for data correlation.
grids.metric_row: 1 row, 4 cols. Used for top-level telemetries (Revenue, Runway, Burn, etc.).

layouts.app_shell: CSS Grid or Flex layout with fixed `260px` sidebar and `calc(100vw - 260px)` main content area.
layouts.page_content: Generous padding inside the main area: `p-8 md:p-12`. Left-aligned semantic HTML. Max-width constraints on readable text (e.g., Reports).
layouts.header: Sticky top bar inside main area. `h-16 backdrop-blur-md bg-[#09090b]/80 border-b border-white/5 z-40`, containing page title and user profile.

motion.transitions: Micro-interactions only. `transition-colors duration-200` on hover. `transform -translate-y-0.5` on card hover. No bouncy or playful animations.
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up for metric cards. `framer-motion` with `ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1]` (custom spring).
motion.loaders: Linear progress bars or minimal spinning mono-circles in `#c9a962`.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure `#c9a962` against `#09090b` passes WCAG AA (it does). Text must be high contrast.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have a visible focus ring `focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#c9a962] focus:outline-none`.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="sidebar-nav-telemetry"`).

ceo_profile.description: Executive portrait for the logged-in CEO user profile top right.

team_meeting.description: Professional team meeting, suitable for the 'People' or 'Team Bandwidth' banner.

alternate_profile.description: Additional portrait for team members in the roster.

3d_libraries.recommendation: Use Recharts for 2D data-dense visualization. For risk matrices or advanced charts, keep it 2D and highly performant. 3D is not required for a 'quiet control' executive dashboard; focus on signal over noise.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a Next.js or React SPA layout (depending on framework setup) utilizing Tailwind CSS.
Set the global background to `#09090b` and text to `#ffffff`.

Implement a fixed sidebar on the left (`w-[260px]`) and a main content area. Make sure to use Lucide React icons for the navigation items (Home, Decisions, Telemetry, Financials, Tasks, Reports, Team, Calendar, People, Ask Kalun, Integrations).
For the 'Morning Executive Briefing' module, build an elevated glassmorphic card that highlights 3 key areas: What changed, What to decide, What to delegate.
Implement high-density metric cards using `DM Mono` for numbers. Align data points precisely.
Do not use generic Shadcn default styles; customize borders to `border-white/5` and use `#c9a962` as the primary action color.
Ensure the taglines 'CEO Operating System' and 'Know what matters before your first meeting' are visibly integrated into the empty states or loading screens.
Do not use transparent backgrounds where content scrolls underneath without a backdrop blur.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not center align the app container. Respect optical alignment.
Never use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements, specifically glass-morphism effects with backdrop-blur-xl and low-opacity borders.
NEVER use Emoji characters for icons. Use `lucide-react`.
Use generous spacing (`p-6` or `p-8`) inside containers, even in high-density layouts, by optimizing font sizes.
Add `data-testid` to all interactive elements for robust automated testing.
Ensure button styles are sharp or slightly rounded (`rounded-md`), avoiding overly playful pill-shapes unless context demands.
Use `sonner` for toast notifications with a dark theme configuration.
